Start date: 1304-02-25  
Subtract 30 weeks = 210 days.  
Subtract 2 more days = 212 days total.  

1304 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
From 1304-02-25, go back:  
Jan 1304 has 31 days → back to 1304-01-25 is 31 days earlier (212 - 31 = 181 left).  
Remaining 181 days into previous year 1303 (not leap, 365 days):  
1303-12-31 is 365 - 181 = 184 days left in 1303 after new date? Let's compute directly:  

From 1304-01-25 back 181 days:  
1304-01-25 → back 25 days to 1304-01-01 → 156 days left (181 - 25 = 156).  
Back into 1303: Dec 31 days, Nov 30, Oct 31, Sep 30, Aug 31, Jul 31, Jun 30 →  
Dec: 31 days (156 - 31 = 125) → date 1303-12-01  
Nov: 30 days (125 - 30 = 95) → date 1303-11-01  
Oct: 31 days (95 - 31 = 64) → date 1303-10-01  
Sep: 30 days (64 - 30 = 34) → date 1303-09-01  
Aug: 31 days (34 - 31 = 3) → date 1303-08-01  
July has 31 days, but we only go back 3 days from Aug 1:  
1303-07-31 (1 day back), 1303-07-30 (2 days back), 1303-07-29 (3 days back).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1303-07-29
